south-america-1998.notes: Only main.html (last modified Dec 1998) has content; the menu frame and the eight section frame sets were archived 2001-2004 and their content pages are not held, so they may belong to later editions. Linked but not held: scores.html (final results), problems/, stat/, fotos/gallery.html, qualification.txt, inf.html; scores.html and problems/ are candidates for capture. The catalogue date is 1998-11-15; the page says 14 November.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw only the 2021 IME-USP institute homepage; our copy now holds the ~cef/acm contest pages, whose main page is about the 1998 contest.
sources.evidence: The main frame page 'Sao Paulo - ACM Programming Contest - Main' welcomes teams to the South American Preliminary held in Antofagasta, Caracas and São Paulo and gives 'November 14, 1998 : Contest date'.

south-america-2006.notes: All nine SPOJ Brasil pages carry a visible 'Problem hidden' notice. The pages were captured while signed in (user menu in the header). Statement figures (spoj.com/content images) returned HTTP 403 and are not held.
